third_party_evaluations.summary: BSI-delivered, CQI/IRCA-certified 5-day ISMS Lead Auditor course (PR373).

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded accredited ISMS audit framework and three-year profile support professional audit responsibilities; completing the five-day course is not evidence of expert governance leadership or an audit portfolio.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded personnel-scheme accreditation, CQI/IRCA registration and three-year profile support professional ISMS audit knowledge. The evidence describes a five-day course and exam, so it should not be read as proof of extensive audit leadership or practical SOC skills.

alex-novak.rationale: ISMS lead-auditor responsibilities and the recorded CQI/IRCA and personnel-accreditation factors support professional assurance work. I do not infer offensive competence or an expert level from the five-day course or price.
